summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill in animation_control/custom_interpolation domain with no semantic overlap to existing skills. Existing skills span reward_computation, codec_generation, and state_inspection—none address custom tween function definition and execution during D3 transitions. Peer candidates (transition inspection, threshold scale lookup, timer scheduling) are orthogonal capabilities. Candidate has clear objective, well-defined intervention moves, and actionable constraints/cautions. Support evidence confirms API availability.
